📖 How to use

  1. Add a row per buy with date, amount invested and price.
  2. Enter the current price of the coin.
  3. Read total invested, coins, average cost and P/L.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is average cost calculated?

Average cost = total invested ÷ total coins bought. Each buy adds amount ÷ price coins to your holdings.

How is current value found?

Enter the current market price — the tool multiplies your total coins by it for current value and profit/loss.

Does this predict future prices?

No — dollar-cost averaging buys on a schedule regardless of price, which this tool tracks. It does not predict or recommend prices.
